workLog.step: Diagnosed why PR #3568 reported BLOCKED while every required check was green. Branch protection here is a ruleset, so repos/OWNER/REPO/branches/main/protection returns 404; gh api repos/rjmurillo/ai-agents/rules/branches/main showed the code_quality rule, and the GraphQL reviewThreads query showed three unresolved Copilot threads.

Fixed the multiplied timeout. run_pytest now computes one deadline from TEST_SUITE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and passes the remaining budget to each pytest command, refusing to start a command once the budget is spent. Before this change, splitting the suite into two processes gave each the full 1740s ceiling, so pre-push could block for twice the intended maximum and outlive lefthook's own deadline.

Wrapped OSError and SyntaxError from the object id validator import so every load failure raises RuntimeError naming the module path, with the original exception preserved as __cause__. Previously a missing file produced a bare FileNotFoundError while a missing symbol produced a RuntimeError, so workflow logs told two different stories for the same class of failure.

Replaced the verbatim argv comparison in test_pre_push_pytest_commands_include_safe_push_module with a parse of the marker expression, targets, and ignores, then asserted the two invariants that carry the safety: exactly one command ignores the safe-push module under 'not integration', exactly one targets it under 'not safe_push_transport', and no command reaches the module without deselecting the transport marker. Adding a benign flag no longer breaks the test.

Ran the revert control. With both production changes stashed, four tests fail (absent-file path naming, unparsable-module path naming, shared timeout budget, refusal past budget) and 35 pass. test_run_pytest_stops_on_the_first_failing_command is a positive control and passes either way, which is correct because it guards pre-existing behavior.

Verified the retrospective gate rather than bypassing it. _today_retrospective_exists accepts today or yesterday, and the most recent retrospective was 2026-07-26, so the date rollover past midnight is what blocked the push. Wrote a real retrospective instead of setting SKIP_RETROSPECTIVE_GATE.
